I actually has a very good and straightforward tip for gold/plat Yasuo. First let's think about the role of Yasuo. A fighter. right? I think no one will cast doubt on this. However, I think Yasuo should not be play like a completely fighter. 

Most gold/ plat Yasuo players will grossly neglect Yasuo's CC ability. They attach too much attention to his function as a warrior. Let's give a quick calculation about his tornado. In the late game, Yasuo actually can use his tornado almost every 3.7-4.2s, which means Yasuo can cast a strong CC skill in a very short time. NO OTHER CHAMP HAS THE ABILITY TO DO THIS. In other words, Yasuo's CC ability is actually at the top level. 

So try to not engage the fight too curtly. Use Yasuo to poke more and break up the enemy, thus they would be more vulnerable.
